newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Mabuhay Vinyl sets IPO plans.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Mabuhay Vinyl sets IPO plans.

text.p: Chemical producer Mabuhay Vinyl Corp said on Monday it will float 223.187 million shares next month at a price between 1.90 and 3.18 pesos a share.
In an advisory to the Philippine Stock Exchange, Mabuhay said the tentative offer period of its IPO has been set from January 13-22, 1997.
The minimum subscription is for 3,000 shares in multiples of 1,000 shares, the company added. A firm offer price will be decided later, the company said.
The listing date is tentatively scheduled on February 6, 1997. BPI Capital Corp has been chosen as lead underwriter.
Mabuhay Vinyl is a producer of polyvinyl chloride (PVC) resin used in the manufacture of pipes and tiles.
Major stockholders of the company are Bank of Philippine Islands, Maria Christina Chemicals Industries Corp, Asian Investment Co Ltd, Eastside Philippines Co Inc and Mitsubishi Corp.
